chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hasan ibn Atiyya, from Yazeed al-Sa'ig, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'A man who holds this position (of Wilayah/leadership), if he narrates he lies, and if he promises he breaks his word, and if he is entrusted he betrays. What is his status?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is the lowest of the levels of disbelief, but he is not a disbeliever.'

key_terms.الْأَمْر: The matter/position of leadership or Wilayah

ai.seo_question: What is the status of a leader who is truthful in speech but untrustworthy in practice?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the spiritual status of a leader who is prone to lying, breaking promises, or betraying trust as being at the 'lowest degree of disbelief' (*adna al-manazil min al-kufr*), a state distinct from full apostasy (*murtadd*). This classification highlights the Shia concept of *Kufr al-Ni'mah* or minor disbelief, where the individual remains within the fold of Islam but possesses a severe deficiency in faith due to these specific character flaws. The ruling underscores the critical importance of *amanah* (trustworthiness) in leadership, linking moral integrity directly to the validity of one's religious standing.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hasan Bin Atiyya, from Yazeed Al Sa’ig who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A man of this matter (Al-Willayah), if he narrates he lies, and if he promises he breaks, and if he is entrusted he betrays. What is his status?’ Heasws said: ‘It is the closest of the levels from the disbelief, but he is not a disbeliever’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hassan ibn ‘Atiyyah from Yazid al-Sa’igh who has said the following: “

Once I said to abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) ‘A man who is in this cause (belief of Shi’a Muslims), but the words he speaks are lies, disregards his promise, and violates his trust. What is his value?’ The Imam said, ‘It is very close to disbelief but he is not an unbeliever.’”
